verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents recruiter-configurable application form questions, knockout or disqualification rules, or EEOC/demographic data collection. The nearest items are adjacent: career-site contact forms, an API endpoint to create applications, a generic "custom, flexible configurations" claim, and an AI Form Builder for onboarding documents. None of these is the application-form capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly
